The comparison cannot run yet because **Continue Current Staffing** has no stated effect on any factor, so it has no connection to the productivity goal.

The three hiring options are structurally ready:
- Tech Lead sets Tech-lead capacity to **8 capacity points (0–10)**.
- Two Developers sets Developer capacity to **12 capacity points (0–20)**.
- One Developer sets Developer capacity to **10 capacity points (0–20)**.

To include the status-quo option, say which factor it changes and to what level — for example, whether it leaves developer capacity at **8 capacity points (0–20)**, tech-lead capacity at **4 capacity points (0–10)**, or both.
